title: AutoCaLC
headline: Automated curriculum selection through a teacher-student loop
summary: AutoCaLC uses a Q-learning teacher with UCB exploration to sequence interventions for a PPO student, updating the curriculum from validation learning-progress rewards. Architecture, Q-table, and benchmark visualizations make the training process inspectable.
problem: Robot training curricula require choices about which interventions to present and when, while the student's learning state changes throughout training.
contribution: A teacher-student loop in which a Q-learning teacher uses UCB exploration to select intervention transitions from validation learning-progress rewards produced by PPO student training.
pipeline: Observe the current curriculum and student learning state.
Select an intervention transition with a Q-table and UCB exploration.
Train and validate the PPO student.
Update the teacher from validation learning-progress rewards.
evidence: Architecture figure and Q-table evolution animation.
Benchmark and validation visualizations under paper_visualizations/.
Runnable teacher-student and baseline entry points.
limitations: No public project paper or hosted demo is currently approved for publication on this site.
